description: Key model of the original firmware and APP=fw (docs/spec/application.md, keys and screens). Expanding a scenario with this keymap must give exactly the key presses it had before it used intents.

notes.open_list: HOME, or the channel's own screen: G1/G2 opens the program list for that generator
notes.focus: another channel's screen: G1/G2 shows that channel (its list when it has no program)
notes.nav_up: UP: previous list entry / calibration index
notes.nav_down: DOWN: next list entry / calibration index
notes.confirm: START in the list: load the selected program into the list's generator
notes.back: STOP in the list: back to the channel screen
notes.play_pause: START on a channel screen: run / pause
notes.stop: STOP on a channel screen: stop
notes.loop: LOOP on a channel screen: run in a loop
notes.stop_all: POWER, short press: stop both generators
notes.power_hold: POWER held 1.5 s: goodbye screen, then power off
notes.screen_toggle: nx only (screen off / on): no key
notes.wake: nx only (wake a dark screen): no key
notes.locked_try: nx only (a key while locked): no key
